# Go Atlas

> Go Atlas is the video editor for maps. It brings a classic video-editing workflow — timeline, keyframes, 3D camera, effects, 4K export — to animated maps, for travel films, documentary geography, and news explainers.

Go Atlas is a native OpenFX plugin for DaVinci Resolve (Windows 10/11, real-time, GPU-accelerated). Projects stay local on the user's machine and are GDPR-compliant. Map tiles are served by Go Atlas itself, from open sources.

## Product
- [Home](https://getgoatlas.com): Overview, demo, features, and pricing.

## What it does
- Cinematic 3D map camera (tilt, altitude, bearing)
- Timeline with a bezier keyframe / curve editor
- Routes, animated labels, icons, and custom shapes
- Built-in effects and presets (glow, blur, shadow, extrusion)
- 4K export — videos you own, commercial use allowed

## Pricing
- Early Access — €249 once, perpetual license, maps included
- First 30 licenses — €149 once (-€100)

## Who it's for
Travel filmmakers, documentary editors, YouTube explainer creators, and journalists.
